patches.name: Disable RASP
patches.description: Bypasses device security checks such as root, USB debugging, and modified environment detection, so the app can be used normally on any device.

patches.name: Allow Plaintext HTTP Traffic
patches.description: Allows cleartext HTTP connections to local self-hosted servers.

patches.name: Bypass Root Detection
patches.description: Disables root detection, allowing the app to run on rooted devices.

patches.name: Disable SSL Pinning
patches.description: Disables SSL certificate pinning to allow intercepting and inspecting network traffic.

patches.name: Disable TLS Validation
patches.description: Disables hostname verification and certificate chain validation for self-signed or invalid certificates.

patches.name: Reroute API Calls to Self-Hosted Server
patches.description: Redirects API requests from Ola servers to your custom backend.
